name: Greek yogurt protein bowl
steps: Stir the yogurt, oats and chia in a bowl. Add 1–2 tablespoons of water if it feels too thick.
Fold in half the blueberries, then scatter the rest on top. Let stand for 5 minutes for softer oats.
notes: One bowl. Use plain nonfat yogurt and dry rolled oats.

name: Egg scramble & apple oatmeal
steps: Dice the apple. Simmer the oats and apple in water over low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring until creamy.
Whisk eggs and whites together. Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat for 3–5 minutes, folding gently, until fully set (160°F / 71°C for the egg mixture).
Serve the scramble beside the oatmeal.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Golden tofu & potato skillet
steps: Dice the potatoes into 1 cm cubes. Microwave with a splash of water, covered loosely, for 5–7 minutes until just tender.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes. Heat the measured oil over medium-high heat; brown the tofu for 6–8 minutes, turning to color both sides.
Drain potatoes and add to the skillet. Cook for 4–5 minutes until lightly crisp. Fold in spinach for the final 1–2 minutes, until wilted.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Lemon-pepper chicken & rice
steps: Rinse the measured dry rice. Add water using the package ratio, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for the package cooking time. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken into even bite-size pieces. Cook in a hot skillet with the measured oil for 7–10 minutes, turning often, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F / 74°C.
Cut broccoli into bite-size florets. Steam for 4–6 minutes until bright green and fork-tender. Serve with rice and chicken.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Smoky turkey & sweet potato bowl
steps: Heat oven to 425°F / 220°C. Dice sweet potato into 1.5 cm cubes, toss with measured oil and roast 20–25 minutes, turning once, until tender.
Cook the turkey over medium-high heat for 7–9 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles, until it reaches 165°F / 74°C.
Steam the frozen vegetables according to the bag, until hot throughout. Spoon turkey and vegetables over sweet potato.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Lemon-herb tuna & bean salad
steps: Drain the tuna; rinse and drain the canned beans thoroughly. Wash spinach and pat dry.
Flake tuna into a bowl. Fold in beans, spinach and measured oil without mashing the beans.
Add optional seasonings, toss gently and serve at once.
notes: Use drained weights for both canned ingredients.

name: Warm lentil rice & greens
steps: Rinse the measured dry rice. Add water using the package ratio, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for the package cooking time. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Warm drained cooked lentils with the measured oil and 2 tablespoons of water in a skillet over medium heat for 3–4 minutes.
Add spinach and stir for 1–2 minutes until wilted. Serve over rice.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Crisp tofu & broccoli rice bowl
steps: Rinse the measured dry rice. Add water using the package ratio, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for the package cooking time. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into 2 cm cubes. Heat the measured oil over medium-high heat; brown the tofu for 6–8 minutes, turning to color both sides.
Steam broccoli for 4–6 minutes until crisp-tender. Add it to the tofu for the last minute, then spoon over rice.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Cottage cheese banana bowl
steps: Peel and slice the banana. Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Arrange banana on top, sprinkle with chia and let stand 2–3 minutes before eating.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Warm bean & avocado bowl
steps: Warm the drained beans in a saucepan with 2 tablespoons of water over medium heat for 3–5 minutes.
Steam the vegetables according to their package. Fold into the beans.
Dice the avocado just before serving and scatter over the bowl.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Banana peanut oatmeal
steps: Bring oats and package-directed water to a simmer. Cook over low heat 5–7 minutes, stirring until soft.
Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and chia. Add a splash of water if needed.
Slice the banana over the top.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Berry tofu smoothie bowl
steps: Drain the tofu well. Peel the banana and add to a blender with tofu and blueberries.
Blend until smooth, adding water one tablespoon at a time. Keep the mixture thick enough to eat with a spoon.
Pour into a bowl and stir in chia. Rest 5 minutes to thicken.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Overnight vanilla protein oats
steps: Whisk yogurt and protein powder with 80–120 mL water until smooth. Stir in oats.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Stir well and top with berries before eating.
notes: 5 minutes active preparation; requires at least 4 hours chilling.

name: Egg-white breakfast sandwich
steps: Toast the bread. Mash avocado with a fork and spread over one slice.
In a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, wilt spinach with a splash of water. Add egg whites and cook 3–5 minutes until completely set (160°F / 71°C).
Fold the eggs onto the toast and close the sandwich.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Cinnamon protein French toast
steps: Whisk egg whites with cinnamon in a shallow dish. Dip each bread slice for 10–15 seconds per side; reserve no raw egg mixture for serving.
Cook in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side, until golden and the egg coating is fully cooked to 160°F / 71°C.
Top with yogurt and berries.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Cottage cheese & berry crunch
steps: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl and fold in half the berries.
Scatter dry oats, chia and the remaining berries on top. Rest 5 minutes if you prefer softer oats.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Potato & pepper egg scramble
steps: Dice potato and pepper. Microwave potato with a splash of water for 5–7 minutes until tender.
Heat oil over medium heat. Fry potato and pepper for 4–5 minutes.
Whisk eggs and whites, pour into the skillet and fold gently for 3–5 minutes until fully set (160°F / 71°C).
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Banana oat protein pancakes
steps: Blend oats into a coarse flour, then blend with banana and egg whites. Rest the batter 2 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Spoon small pancakes into the pan and cook 2–3 minutes per side, until the centers are set and reach 160°F / 71°C.
Serve with yogurt.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Chicken & egg breakfast bowl
steps: Dice potatoes and microwave with a splash of water for 6–8 minutes until tender.
Cut the chicken into even bite-size pieces. Cook in a hot skillet with the measured oil for 7–10 minutes, turning often, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F / 74°C.
Add potato and spinach to the pan for 2 minutes. Make a space for the egg and cook until white and yolk are firm. Serve together.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Yogurt with toasted oats & apple
steps: Toast oats in a dry skillet over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, stirring until fragrant. Let cool slightly.
Dice apple. Spoon yogurt into a bowl, add apple and toasted oats, and swirl in peanut butter.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Savory cottage cheese toast
steps: Toast bread until crisp. Dice pepper and avocado into small pieces.
Spread cottage cheese over toast and top with vegetables. Press toppings down lightly before serving.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Quinoa egg & greens bowl
steps: Rinse quinoa and simmer with package-directed water, covered, until the water is absorbed and the germ curls away, about 15 minutes.
Warm oil in a nonstick pan. Wilt spinach, then add beaten eggs and whites. Fold over medium-low heat until fully set (160°F / 71°C).
Serve the scramble over quinoa.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Weeknight turkey & bean chili
steps: Dice pepper and carrot. Heat oil in a saucepan and soften vegetables over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Cook the turkey over medium-high heat for 7–9 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles, until it reaches 165°F / 74°C.
Add drained beans, optional spices and 100–150 mL water. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until thick and vegetables are tender.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Dill salmon with quinoa & beans
steps: Heat oven to 400°F / 200°C. Rinse quinoa and simmer using the package water ratio, about 15 minutes.
Place salmon on baking parchment. Roast 12–16 minutes until the center reaches 145°F / 63°C and flakes easily.
Steam green beans 5–7 minutes until tender-crisp. Serve alongside salmon and quinoa.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Chicken, spinach & pepper pasta
steps: Boil pasta in water according to its package until just tender. Reserve a little cooking water.
Cut the chicken into even bite-size pieces. Cook in a hot skillet with the measured oil for 7–10 minutes, turning often, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F / 74°C.
Slice pepper and add to the chicken for 3 minutes, then wilt in spinach. Toss with pasta and a splash of cooking water.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Turkey & avocado taco wraps
steps: Cook the turkey over medium-high heat for 7–9 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles, until it reaches 165°F / 74°C.
Slice peppers finely and add for the final 3–4 minutes of cooking with optional taco spices.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 20–30 seconds per side. Fill with turkey, peppers and diced avocado.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Herby lentil & spinach pasta
steps: Boil pasta until just tender using package instructions. Save 3 tablespoons of pasta water.
Warm lentils and oil in a skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes. Add spinach until wilted.
Toss with pasta and reserved water. Season and serve hot.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Peanut tofu noodle bowl
steps: Boil pasta according to the package. Cut tofu into small cubes and grate carrots.
Whisk peanut butter with 2–4 tablespoons of hot pasta water until pourable.
Drain pasta, return to the warm pot and toss with tofu, carrots and peanut sauce over low heat for 2–3 minutes until hot throughout.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Beef & pepper rice skillet
steps: Rinse the measured dry rice. Add water using the package ratio, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for the package cooking time. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Slice the beef into thin strips and pepper into narrow pieces. Heat oil over medium-high heat and brown beef 2–3 minutes per side.
Add pepper and cook until just tender. For intact beef strips, verify 145°F / 63°C and rest 3 minutes; use 160°F / 71°C if substituting ground beef. Serve over rice.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Tuna avocado toast & carrots
steps: Toast bread until crisp. Drain tuna and mash avocado with a fork.
Spread avocado on toast and pile tuna on top. Cut carrots into sticks and serve alongside.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Chicken & sweet potato tray bake
steps: Heat oven to 425°F / 220°C. Dice sweet potatoes into 1.5 cm cubes and toss with half the measured oil on a tray. Roast for 10 minutes.
Add chicken pieces and broccoli with remaining oil. Roast 15–20 minutes more, turning vegetables once.
Check chicken reaches 165°F / 74°C and potatoes are tender before serving.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Quinoa, bean & avocado salad
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook with package-directed water until fluffy, about 15 minutes. Spread on a plate to cool briefly.
Rinse and drain beans. Dice pepper and avocado.
Fold everything together gently. Serve warm or cool.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Tofu breakfast burrito
steps: Heat oil over medium heat. Dice pepper and cook for 3 minutes.
Crumble tofu into the pan and add optional spices. Cook 5–6 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan, add filling and fold the sides inward before rolling.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Loaded lentil baked potato
steps: Scrub and prick potato. Microwave on a plate for 8–12 minutes, turning halfway, until the center is tender.
Warm lentils with a splash of water over medium heat for 3–4 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Split potato, fluff the center with a fork and spoon over lentils. Finish with yogurt.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Ginger chicken vegetable stir-fry
steps: Rinse the measured dry rice. Add water using the package ratio, bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low for the package cooking time. Rest covered for 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken into even bite-size pieces. Cook in a hot skillet with the measured oil for 7–10 minutes, turning often, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F / 74°C.
Add frozen vegetables and 2 tablespoons of water, cover for 3–4 minutes, then uncover and stir-fry until hot and tender-crisp. Serve with rice.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Creamy bean & spinach skillet
steps: Warm drained beans and measured oil with 60 mL water in a skillet over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Mash about a quarter of the beans against the pan to thicken the sauce. Fold in spinach for 1–2 minutes.
Toast bread and serve beside the skillet.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Paprika salmon & crushed potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 400°F / 200°C. Dice potatoes and boil in water for 12–15 minutes until tender.
Bake salmon on parchment for 12–16 minutes, until it reaches 145°F / 63°C and flakes easily.
Steam broccoli 4–6 minutes. Lightly crush drained potatoes with a fork and serve with fish and broccoli.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Turkey quinoa pepper skillet
steps: Rinse quinoa and simmer in package-directed water until fluffy, about 15 minutes.
Cook the turkey over medium-high heat for 7–9 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles, until it reaches 165°F / 74°C.
Add diced pepper for 4–5 minutes. Fold in spinach until wilted, then combine with quinoa.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Apple & yogurt peanut dip
steps: Stir peanut butter into yogurt until smooth. Add a teaspoon of water if needed.
Core and slice apple. Serve the slices with the yogurt dip.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Egg & avocado toast
steps: Toast the bread and spread with mashed avocado.
Cook eggs in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat until yolks and whites are firm. Serve on toast.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Berry protein yogurt
steps: Whisk protein powder into yogurt a little at a time, adding 1–2 tablespoons of water to smooth any lumps.
Fold in berries and serve.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Lemony bean dip & carrot sticks
steps: Blend rinsed, drained beans with oil and 2–4 tablespoons water until creamy.
Add optional seasonings and pulse again. Cut carrots into sticks and serve with the dip.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.

name: Cottage cheese cinnamon toast
steps: Toast bread. Spoon cottage cheese on top and scatter blueberries over it.
Finish with cinnamon if desired and eat while the toast is crisp.
notes: Weights refer to the ingredient form shown. Water and optional dry seasonings add no tracked portions.
